review_candidates.description: Über Uns SOLAR MATERIALS steht für zukunftsweisende Recyclinglösungen im Bereich der Photovoltaik. Als Innovationsführer entwickeln wir effiziente, nachhaltige und wirtschaftliche Kreislaufmodelle für das Lebensende von Solarmodulen – und leisten damit einen essenziellen Beitrag zur nachhaltigen Energiewende. Unsere Mission: die Solarindustrie kreislauffähig machen. Deine Aufgaben SOLAR MATERIALS macht Solarmodule recycelbar – effizient, wirtschaftlich und nachhaltig. Als Key Account Manager bringst du unsere Lösung dorthin, wo sie gebraucht wird: zu EPCs, O&M-Dienstleistern, Asset Managern und Investoren. Dein Fokus: Business Development entlang der Solar-Wertschöpfungskette – nicht klassischer Vertrieb, sondern strategischer Lösungsvertrieb im Kontext von ESG, End-of-Life-Strategien und regulatorischen Anforderungen. Du baust unsere Kundenbeziehungen auf dem niederländischen Markt gezielt aus und erschließt neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten für unsere Recyclinglösungen. Deine Hauptaufgaben sind: Zielgruppen entwickeln: EPCs Q&M, Asset Manager, Investoren – du kennst ihre Sprache und Herausforderungen Lösungen verkaufen: Du positionierst unser Recycling als festen Baustein nachhaltiger Solarprojekte Projekte begleiten: Von der Ausschreibung bis zur Umsetzung, eng mit Technik und Logistik Markt im Blick behalten: Du verstehst, wo sich regulatorisch und strategisch neue Chancen ergeben Dein Profil Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaft, Ingenieurwesen, Umwelttechnik oder vergleichbare Ausbildung Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, idealerweise im Bezug zu erneuerbaren Energien, EPCs, Q&M oder Asset Management Kenntnisse im Projektgeschäft und in Ausschreibungsprozessen starke Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten Strategisches Denken kombiniert mit Hands-on-Mentalität Fähigkeit, nachhaltige Lösungen in einem technischen/regulatorischen Umfeld überzeugend zu präsentieren Reisebereitschaft (national/international) Sehr gute Deutsch-, Englisch- und Niederländischkenntnisse Warum wir? Gestaltungsspielraum: Du arbeitest in einem dynamischen Umfeld mit viel Platz für eigene Ideen und unternehmerisches Handeln Impact: Deine Arbeit trägt direkt zur Kreislaufwirtschaft und nachhaltigen Transformation der Solarbranche bei Wertschätzende Zusammenarbeit: Wir leben flache Hierarchien, offene Kommunaktion und ein starkes Teamgefühl – wir ziehen gemeinsam an einem Strang Flexibilität: moderne Arbeitsmodelle mit Remote-Option, flexible Arbeitszeiten und eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance Sinn & Perspektive: Arbeiten mit Purpose – in einem wachsenden Zukunftsmarkt mit echter gesellschaftlicher Relevanz Über uns Wir von SOLAR MATERIALS sind ein führendes Recyclingunternehmen, das sich auf das umweltfreundliche und nachhaltige Recycling von Solarmodulen spezialisiert hat. Unser Ziel ist der Aufbau einer zirkulären Solarindustrie, um die Solarenergie zu einer ganzheitlich grünen Energieform zu machen. Nach dem erfolgreichen Start unserer Pilotlinie in Magdeburg gehen wir nun den nächsten Schritt: den Ausbau weiterer Standorte, um noch mehr Solarmodule recyceln zu können. Dafür suchen wir engagierte Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die Lust haben, unser Unternehmen weiterzuentwickeln und Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Was uns wichtig ist? Eigeninitiative, Praxiserfahrung und frische Ideen – und die Bereitschaft, diese auch schnell in die Tat umzusetzen. Dich erwartet ein abwechslungsreicher Arbeitsalltag mit spannenden Herausforderungen und viel Raum für persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung.

Je ontwikkelt strategische samenwerkingen en partnerships binnen jouw regio. Je coördineert aanbestedingstrajecten en werkt nauw samen met verschillende interne afdelingen. Je ondersteunt bij de opmaak van offertes en volgt commerciële dossiers nauwgezet op. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van binnenkomende bestellingen en zorgt voor een correcte opvolging. Je volgt marktontwikkelingen, concurrentieactiviteiten en relevante wetgeving op. Je onderhoudt contacten met autoriteiten en externe instanties. Je werkt actief mee aan de verdere uitbouw van de commerciële strategie binnen de Benelux. Je leidt commerciële projecten van A tot Z en bewaakt planning, deadlines en deliverables. Je zorgt voor een vlotte samenwerking tussen de verschillende interne afdelingen. Kandidaatprofiel: Je beschikt over een bachelor- of masterdiploma in een commerciële, technische of economische richting. review_candidates.description: Danish Refugee Council, one of the world’s leading humanitarian NGOs, is currently looking for a highly qualified HR and Administration Coordinator. About The Job To provide advice, coordination, capacity building and technical support to HR focal person at field location and overall coordination of HR tasks at country level. The Human Resources Coordinator ensures compliance to DRC's human resource procedures and guidelines within the country operations. The role contributes to the development of country strategies, which are translated into action plans and day-to-day tasks. The job is based in Tunis with potential 20% travel to field offices. Your main duties and responsibilities will be: Human Resources Support Provide technical support and advice to the Human Resources team Advise and assist managers in Human Resources related issues and concerns Recruitment HR focal person for recruitments of national and expat staff (excluding bands C, D & E with HQ) Define and ensure proper onboarding process for new staff Coordinate and organize inductions on country level on a regular basis, including coordination with facilitators and participants Ensure oversight and consistency in position titles and grades, across all field locations. Advise hiring managers in development of Job description, inclusive job advertisements and team structures. HR Function and compliance Developing/updating HR policies, Employee/HR Handbook, procedures and tools and close monitoring to ensure compliance. Collaborate with Senior Management Team in the analysis of the organizational structure across the three countries to ensure consistency, coherency, and efficiency Focal point for DRC coordination office legal matters, liaison with legal Advisor and monitoring of ongoing/ new legal cases against DRC. Supporting country director in keeping the registration status updated to incorporate changes in legal representative etc. by seeking timely support from legal advisors on the process. Advise and train HR and admin focal person in digitalization of HR and Admin tools and platforms. Coordination with finance unit to ensure payroll, taxes are captured accurately in the three countries. Learning and Development, Performance, and Well-being Support managers & staff with performance management and review processes, including providing specialized trainings like People management skills. Act as an impartial mediator in disciplinary procedures and ensure that they follow DRC policies and meet all legal and labor regulations and requirements Implementation of Global, regional, and country level HR initiatives example (DRC Voices, minimum standards, staff wellbeing, diversity, and inclusion etc) Coordinate with senior managers to develop country wide training calendar. Compensation And Benefits Take lead in salary review process in partnership with service provider, Finance team, Senior Management team at country and HQ and coordinate compensation review process and compensation adjustments. Analysis of benchmarking reports and the design of new salary grids; Support implementation of DRC’s new Compensation policy, including salary progression Prepare monthly payroll for Tunisia and review Algeria and Libya payroll to ensure compliance. Register employees in social security for all LE hosted by TUN legal entity. DRC Dynamics and Digitalization and reporting Follow up the correct implementation of DRC Dynamics (HR Module) and the quality of the data entered in the system. Train HR focal person in TUN, Libya and Algeria and where required others in WANALA region. Monitoring accuracy and timely update of master data in dynamics for TUN, Libya and Algeria for the HR module Producing monthly HR reports for TUN, Libya and Algeria Ensure org chart for TUN, Libya and Algeria are up to date and produce when required by managers Develop/update HR templates digital/manual (recruitment tracker, onboarding and offboarding checklist and forms, recruitment request forms, exit clearance forms, contract request etc) Manage digital spaces like Share point (HR), MACH forms etc Provide training in Dynamics (HR Module) for HR focal person and relevant module like Employee self-service to new joiners Developing and maintaining full record of legal status/file of DRC’s registration in Tunisia. Partnerships: Participate actively to the assessment of local partners capacities in terms of HR from the compliance and transparency perspective. Provide technical training to local partners in the fields covered by the scope of work of the HR coordinator Position. Code of Conduct Will support country director in ensuring that required CoC structure is in place at country office. Coordinates with HQ and regional CoC focal person to seek technical inputs on the subject. Support country director in managing CoC structure in the country/operation. About You To be successful in this role we expect you to have at least 3 years’ working experience (officer and above) in Human Resources functions, preferably within an NGO. Moreover, we also expect the following: Required Demonstrated understanding and working knowledge/experience of Human Resources Management principles, concepts & processes Ability to interpret and transform local labor laws in DRC internal policies. Experience in developing Human Resources strategies and policies, and driving implementation Experience using an online system for recruitments and ERP system Payroll management and experience in salary benchmarking exercise Experience and understanding of local labour laws and managing legal services BA in Human Resources, Management, Administration or related subject is mandatory Fluency in French and Tunisian language is must Working knowledge of English is mandatory Desired MA in a related subject is desired In this position, you are expected to demonstrate DRC’ five core competencies: Striving for excellence: You focus on reaching results while ensuring an efficient process. Collaborating: You involve relevant parties and encourage feedback. Taking the lead: You take ownership and initiative while aiming for innovation. Communicating: You listen and speak effectively and honestly. Demonstrating integrity: You uphold and promote the highest standards of ethical and professional conduct in relation to our values and Code of Conduct, including safeguarding against sexual exploitation, abuse and harassment. We offer Contract length: Open ended with 6 months probation period Band: Non management G level 1 Designation of Duty Station: Tunis, Tunisia Suggested Start date: 01 December 2026 Salary and conditions will be in accordance with Danish Refugee Council’s Terms of Employment for national employees; please refer to our website . For questions regarding the vacancy please contact Us . Application process All applicants must upload a cover letter and an updated CV (no longer than four pages) in English. A pplications sent by email will not be considered. Closing date for applications: 01 November 2026 For further information about the Danish Refugee Council, please consult our website drc.ngo .

review_candidates.description: Work Location: El Ein El Sokhna, Suez Preferred Residence Suez / Madinet Nasr / Tagamoaa ROLE SUMMARY The Site Supervisor acts as the on-ground HR representative responsible for managing day-to-day HR operations on site. review_candidates.title: HDD Supervisor
review_candidates.description: Job Description MME Underground Services specialises in the installation of underground infrastructure by trenchless technologies and civil construction methods. We deliver projects in the Perth metropolitan area and including the heart of the Perth CBD. We are currently looking for an experienced Horizontal Directional Drilling Supervisor with a minimum of 5 years experience supervising and preferred experience working on the Western Power network to join the team located at our Belmont facility. The Supervisor is responsible for the day-to-day implementation of a site’s construction plan, as delegated by the Site Manager, to ensure its safe, effective and efficient delivery. This may involve planning, preparing, initiating, monitoring, adjusting and reporting on the delivery of the works, and monitoring of day labour’s and subcontractors’ performance. Position Requirements Experience installing conduits and underground cables on Western Power projects. Access, interpret and apply compliance documentation relevant to the work activity. Relay HSEQ rules and regulations, legislation and specific site instructions to team and subcontractors. Contribute to the identification of site-specific delivery risks, and contingencies to be allowed for in the execution of the works Oversee site set-up, mobilisation and demobilisation as directed by the Site Manager. Monitor the availability of materials to meet work schedules and the requirements of the works package. Establish and maintain strong relationships with internal and external clients and key stakeholders as appropriate to the role. Provide support for the HDD Drillers and Driller Offsiders personnel, to ensure that the quality of the expected outcomes of the works. Manage the performance of day labour and subcontractors, and provide coaching as required to support their development. Essential criteria: Minimum 5 years experience in Supervising Horizonal Directional Drilling Strong supervisory and people management skills Must be able to read and interpret plans/drawings and as constructed drawings High regard for safety and quality Intermediate computer skills Desirable criteria: Knowledge of Western Power requirements Western Power NAC Card First Aid Certificate The position is full-time for an immediate start, working with an excellent team on great pay and conditions. MME is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islanders peoples and women.

review_candidates.title: Greek Audio Transcriber (Remotely)
review_candidates.description: Company Description DatoviaPlayHouse is a global freelance marketplace that connects businesses with skilled professionals and AI-powered solutions across more than 300 languages. The platform supports a wide range of services, including localization, transcription, AI data services, and digital operations for organizations of all sizes. By combining human expertise with advanced technology, DatoviaPlayHouse delivers accurate, scalable, and cost-effective solutions tailored to modern business needs. With a diverse international talent network, the company helps clients expand into new markets, optimize workflows, and achieve efficient, data-driven growth. Role Description The Greek Audio Transcriber (Remotely) is a full-time role focused on accurately transcribing spoken Greek audio into high-quality written text. Day-to-day tasks include listening to audio files, segmenting speech, transcribing content with correct grammar and spelling, and following project-specific guidelines and formatting standards. The role also involves verifying audio clarity, performing quality checks, and making necessary corrections to ensure consistency and accuracy. The position is fully remote, requiring reliable internet access, adherence to deadlines, and effective communication with project managers and other team members. Qualifications Strong command of Greek (native or near-native proficiency) and solid understanding of grammar, spelling, and punctuation. High level of listening accuracy and attention to detail for audio transcription and text review. Proficiency in using transcription tools, text editors, and common productivity software. Ability to follow style guides, formatting rules, and project requirements consistently. Excellent time management skills and ability to meet deadlines while working independently in a remote environment. Comfort with handling confidential or sensitive information in accordance with data protection guidelines. Previous experience in transcription, linguistics, or localization is preferred but not mandatory. Reliable computer, headset, and stable internet connection suitable for streaming and processing audio files.
